# Comet UI

> Plain CSS design system with atomic design (atoms, molecules, organisms, templates), three-tier design tokens, light and dark themes and swappable brands. Class prefix `cu-`. No framework needed.

GENERATED by scripts/build-tokens.mjs from tokens/ and src/. Do not edit by hand.

## Use it

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/comet-ui/dist/comet.min.css">
<script src="node_modules/comet-ui/dist/comet.min.js" defer></script>
<html data-cu-theme="light" data-cu-brand="neutral">
```

- Theme: `data-cu-theme="light|dark"` on any element. Brand: `data-cu-brand="neutral|comet|ocean"` on any element. Both can be nested.
- Style components with semantic tokens only (`var(--cu-primary)`), never hex values or primitives.
- Behaviour comes from `comet.js` through data attributes (`data-cu-open`, `data-cu-table`, `data-cu-tabs`...). After adding markup with JavaScript, call `CometUI.init(container)`. Toasts: `CometUI.toast({ title, description, variant })`.
- New brand: `npx comet-ui brand create <name> --primary <hex>`, then `npx comet-ui brand build <file>`. No component code changes.
- Tailwind v4: `@import "comet-ui/tailwind.css"` maps the tokens to bg-primary, text-foreground, border-border...

## Semantic tokens

- `--cu-background`: light var(--cu-white), dark var(--cu-slate-950). Page background
- `--cu-foreground`: light var(--cu-slate-950), dark var(--cu-slate-50). Default text
- `--cu-surface`: light var(--cu-white), dark var(--cu-slate-900). Cards, inputs, popovers, dialogs
- `--cu-muted`: light var(--cu-slate-100), dark var(--cu-slate-800). Quiet fills: hover rows, segmented track, avatar
- `--cu-muted-foreground`: light var(--cu-slate-600), dark var(--cu-slate-400). Secondary text
- `--cu-subtle-foreground`: light var(--cu-slate-500), dark var(--cu-slate-500). Placeholders, icons, hints
- `--cu-border`: light var(--cu-slate-300), dark var(--cu-slate-700). Default borders and dividers
- `--cu-border-strong`: light var(--cu-slate-400), dark var(--cu-slate-600). Emphasised borders
- `--cu-primary`: light var(--cu-primary-light), dark var(--cu-primary-dark). Main action fill. Chosen by the brand for each theme
- `--cu-primary-hover`: light var(--cu-primary-hover-light), dark var(--cu-primary-hover-dark)
- `--cu-primary-foreground`: light var(--cu-primary-foreground-light), dark var(--cu-primary-foreground-dark). Text on primary
- `--cu-brand-subtle`: light var(--cu-brand-50), dark var(--cu-brand-950). Tinted brand fill
- `--cu-brand-subtle-foreground`: light var(--cu-brand-600), dark var(--cu-brand-300). Text on brand-subtle
- `--cu-brand-border`: light var(--cu-brand-300), dark var(--cu-brand-700)
- `--cu-ring`: light var(--cu-ring-light), dark var(--cu-ring-dark). Selected / focused outline
- `--cu-focus-border`: light var(--cu-brand-400), dark var(--cu-brand-500)
- `--cu-focus-halo`: light var(--cu-brand-100), dark var(--cu-brand-900)
- `--cu-inverse`: light var(--cu-slate-950), dark var(--cu-slate-50). Opposite surface: tooltip, default badge, checked radio
- `--cu-inverse-foreground`: light var(--cu-white), dark var(--cu-slate-950)
- `--cu-destructive`: light var(--cu-red-600), dark var(--cu-red-600). Danger fill
- `--cu-destructive-foreground`: light var(--cu-white), dark var(--cu-white)
- `--cu-destructive-subtle`: light var(--cu-red-50), dark var(--cu-red-950)
- `--cu-destructive-subtle-foreground`: light var(--cu-red-700), dark var(--cu-red-400). Danger text on surface or destructive-subtle
- `--cu-success`: light var(--cu-green-600), dark var(--cu-green-600). Success fill / dot
- `--cu-success-subtle`: light var(--cu-green-50), dark var(--cu-green-950)
- `--cu-success-subtle-foreground`: light var(--cu-green-700), dark var(--cu-green-400)
- `--cu-warning`: light var(--cu-amber-500), dark var(--cu-amber-500). Indicator / fill only. Too light for text on white
- `--cu-warning-subtle`: light var(--cu-amber-50), dark var(--cu-amber-950)
- `--cu-warning-subtle-foreground`: light var(--cu-amber-700), dark var(--cu-amber-400). Warning text on warning-subtle or surface
- `--cu-chart-1`: light var(--cu-primary-light), dark var(--cu-primary-dark). Chart series 1. Follows the brand primary
- `--cu-chart-2`: light var(--cu-green-600), dark var(--cu-green-400). Chart series 2
- `--cu-chart-3`: light var(--cu-amber-500), dark var(--cu-amber-400). Chart series 3
- `--cu-chart-4`: light var(--cu-red-500), dark var(--cu-red-400). Chart series 4
- `--cu-chart-5`: light var(--cu-slate-500), dark var(--cu-slate-400). Chart series 5
- `--cu-chart-6`: light var(--cu-brand-400), dark var(--cu-brand-600). Chart series 6. A second brand tone
- `--cu-overlay`: light rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.4), dark rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6). Scrim behind modal surfaces

## Brands

- `neutral`: Default brand. Black and white like shadcn/ui: primary is near-black in light and near-white in dark.
- `comet`: Purple, rounded, Plus Jakarta Sans. The original Comet UI look.
- `ocean`: Example second brand. Blue, squarer corners, serif headings.

### atom: avatar

```
Avatar
```

### atom: badge

```
Badge
```

### atom: button

```
Button
```

### atom: checkbox

```
Checkbox
   <label class="cu-checkbox"><input type="checkbox" class="cu-checkbox-input"><span>Label</span></label>
   Set input.indeterminate = true for the mixed state.
```

### atom: divider

```
Divider
```

### atom: icon

```
Icon
   Inline SVG icons that follow the text color. Markup:
   <svg class="cu-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
        stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">...</svg>
```

### atom: input

```
Input, Select, Textarea, Label (+ input group)
```

### atom: kbd

```
Kbd
   <kbd class="cu-kbd">Ctrl</kbd> <kbd class="cu-kbd">K</kbd>
```

### atom: progress

```
Progress bar
   <div class="cu-progress" role="progressbar" aria-valuenow="60" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" style="--cu-value: 60">
     <div class="cu-progress-bar"></div>
   </div>
   Indeterminate: add .cu-progress-indeterminate and leave out aria-valuenow.
```

### atom: radio

```
Radio
```

### atom: scroll-area

```
Scroll area. A scroll container with a thin themed scrollbar.
   <div class="cu-scroll-area" style="max-height: 12rem" tabindex="0">...long content...</div>
   Horizontal: add .cu-scroll-area-x. Keep tabindex="0" so keyboard users can scroll it.
```

### atom: skeleton

```
Skeleton
   Placeholder shapes while content loads. Mark the loading region aria-busy="true".
   <div class="cu-skeleton cu-skeleton-text"></div>
```

### atom: slider

```
Slider (native range input)
   <input type="range" class="cu-slider" min="0" max="100" value="40" aria-label="Volume">
   comet.js keeps the filled part in sync. Without it the track is plain.
```

### atom: spinner

```
Spinner
   <span class="cu-spinner" role="status"><span class="cu-sr-only">Loading</span></span>
   Buttons: <button class="cu-btn cu-btn-primary" aria-busy="true">Saving</button>
   shows a spinner before the label and ignores clicks. Spinners use currentColor.
```

### atom: switch

```
Switch
```

### atom: toggle

```
Toggle (a button that stays pressed) and Toggle group
   <button type="button" class="cu-toggle" data-cu-toggle aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Bold">B</button>

   <div class="cu-toggle-group" role="group" aria-label="Text style" data-cu-toggle-group="multiple">
     <button type="button" class="cu-toggle" aria-pressed="true">Bold</button>
     <button type="button" class="cu-toggle" aria-pressed="false">Italic</button>
   </div>
   data-cu-toggle-group="single" keeps one pressed at most; "multiple" lets each one toggle.
   Variants: .cu-toggle-outline, sizes .cu-toggle-sm and .cu-toggle-lg. Event: cu:toggle.
```

### atom: tooltip

```
Tooltip
```

### molecule: accordion

```
Accordion
```

### molecule: alert

```
Alert / Callout
   <div class="cu-alert cu-alert-success" role="status">
     <svg class="cu-icon cu-alert-icon">...</svg>
     <div class="cu-alert-body">
       <p class="cu-alert-title">Saved</p>
       <p class="cu-alert-description">Your changes are live.</p>
     </div>
     <button type="button" class="cu-alert-close" data-cu-dismiss aria-label="Dismiss">...</button>
   </div>
   Use role="alert" for errors that need attention now, role="status" for the rest.
   Add .cu-alert-callout for a thick left accent.
```

### molecule: attachment

```
Attachment. A file or image with its name, details, actions and upload state.
   <div class="cu-attachment" data-state="done">
     <div class="cu-attachment-media"><svg class="cu-icon">...</svg></div>
     <div class="cu-attachment-content">
       <span class="cu-attachment-title">report.pdf</span>
       <span class="cu-attachment-description">PDF, 2.4 MB</span>
     </div>
     <div class="cu-attachment-actions">
       <button type="button" class="cu-attachment-action" aria-label="Remove report.pdf">...</button>
     </div>
     <button type="button" class="cu-attachment-trigger" aria-label="Open report.pdf"></button>
   </div>
   data-state: idle | uploading | processing | error | done. Uploading and processing shimmer the title;
   error turns it destructive (also say why in the description). Sizes: .cu-attachment-sm, .cu-attachment-xs.
   Image: .cu-attachment-media-image with an <img>; stack it above the text with .cu-attachment-vertical.
   The trigger covers the whole card; actions stay clickable above it.
   Row of attachments: .cu-attachment-group (scrolls sideways and snaps).
```

### molecule: breadcrumb

```
Breadcrumb
```

### molecule: bubble

```
Bubble. The surface of one chat message. Layout around it (avatar, name, time) is the Message.
   <div class="cu-bubble cu-bubble-secondary">
     <div class="cu-bubble-content">Can you send the report?</div>
     <div class="cu-bubble-reactions" role="img" aria-label="2 thumbs up">...</div>
   </div>
   Variants: default (primary, the current user), -secondary, -muted, -tinted, -outline, -ghost (no frame,
   full width, for assistant text), -destructive. Align to the end with .cu-bubble-end.
   Reactions sit on the bottom end edge; .cu-bubble-reactions-top and .cu-bubble-reactions-start move them.
   Clickable bubble: use <button class="cu-bubble-content"> or <a class="cu-bubble-content">.
   Consecutive bubbles from one sender: wrap in .cu-bubble-group.
```

### molecule: button-group

```
Button group
```

### molecule: card

```
Card
```

### molecule: code-block

```
Code block with a copy button.
   <div class="cu-code-block">
     <div class="cu-code-block-header">
       <span class="cu-code-block-title">index.html</span>
       <button type="button" class="cu-code-block-copy" data-cu-copy>Copy</button>
     </div>
     <pre class="cu-code-block-pre" tabindex="0"><code>...escaped code...</code></pre>
   </div>
   data-cu-copy copies the <pre> in the same block. data-cu-copy="#id" copies another element's text.
   Inline code: <code class="cu-code">npm install</code>.
```

### molecule: collapsible

```
Collapsible. One show/hide region on native <details>, so it works without JavaScript.
   <details class="cu-collapsible">
     <summary class="cu-collapsible-trigger">3 repositories <svg class="cu-icon cu-icon-xs">...</svg></summary>
     <div class="cu-collapsible-content">...</div>
   </details>
   For a set of sections where one closes the others, use the Accordion.
```

### molecule: combobox

```
Combobox
```

### molecule: datepicker

```
Datepicker
   <div class="cu-datepicker" data-cu-datepicker data-cu-min="2026-01-01" data-cu-max="2026-12-31">
     <input type="text" class="cu-input" placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" inputmode="numeric" aria-label="Date">
     <button type="button" class="cu-datepicker-toggle" aria-label="Choose date">...</button>
   </div>
   comet.js builds the calendar. Value format is YYYY-MM-DD. Arrow keys move by day and week,
   PageUp/PageDown by month, Esc closes.
```

### molecule: dropdown

```
Dropdown
```

### molecule: empty-state

```
Empty state
   <div class="cu-empty-state">
     <div class="cu-empty-state-icon"><svg class="cu-icon cu-icon-md">...</svg></div>
     <h3 class="cu-empty-state-title">No projects yet</h3>
     <p class="cu-empty-state-description">Create your first project to get started.</p>
     <div class="cu-empty-state-actions"><button class="cu-btn cu-btn-primary">New project</button></div>
   </div>
```

### molecule: field

```
Field = label + control + hint + error, wired for screen readers.
   <div class="cu-field">
     <label class="cu-label" for="email">Email</label>
     <input class="cu-input" id="email" aria-describedby="email-hint">
     <p class="cu-input-hint" id="email-hint">We never share it.</p>
   </div>
   Invalid: put aria-invalid="true" on the control and add <p class="cu-input-error" id="email-error" role="alert">.
   Required: add <span class="cu-field-required" aria-hidden="true">*</span> inside the label.
   Horizontal: .cu-field-row puts label and control on one line (checkbox, switch).
```

### molecule: file-upload

```
File upload
   <div class="cu-file-upload" data-cu-file-upload data-cu-max-size="5242880" data-cu-max-files="5">
     <label class="cu-file-dropzone">
       <input type="file" class="cu-sr-only" multiple accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg">
       <svg class="cu-icon cu-icon-lg">...</svg>
       <span class="cu-file-dropzone-title"><strong>Click to upload</strong> or drag and drop</span>
       <span class="cu-file-dropzone-hint">PDF, PNG or JPG up to 5 MB</span>
     </label>
     <ul class="cu-file-list" aria-live="polite"></ul>
   </div>
   comet.js validates type, size and count, renders the list and keeps input.files in sync.
```

### molecule: hover-card

```
Hover card. A preview that opens when a link is hovered or focused. CSS only.
   <span class="cu-hover-card">
     <a class="cu-hover-card-trigger" href="#">@deni</a>
     <span class="cu-hover-card-content" role="note">...avatar, name, bio...</span>
   </span>
   The content is extra: never put something there that people cannot reach another way.
```

### molecule: input-affix

```
Input with prefix / suffix
```

### molecule: item

```
Item. One row of media + text + actions, for lists and settings.
   <div class="cu-item cu-item-outline">
     <div class="cu-item-media">...icon or avatar...</div>
     <div class="cu-item-content">
       <p class="cu-item-title">Two-factor authentication</p>
       <p class="cu-item-description">Verify with an email code.</p>
     </div>
     <div class="cu-item-actions"><button class="cu-btn cu-btn-outline cu-btn-sm">Enable</button></div>
   </div>
   Variants: .cu-item-outline, .cu-item-muted. As a link or button, use <a class="cu-item"> for hover and focus.
   Stack several inside .cu-item-group to get dividers.
```

### molecule: marker

```
Marker. A line of status or system information inside a conversation.
   <div class="cu-marker" role="status">
     <span class="cu-marker-icon"><span class="cu-spinner"></span></span>
     <span class="cu-marker-content cu-shimmer">Searching the docs</span>
   </div>
   Variants: .cu-marker-border (line under the row), .cu-marker-separator (centred label between two lines,
   for date breaks). Use role="status" only on markers that update while the person waits.
   As a link or button: <a class="cu-marker"> or <button class="cu-marker">.
```

### molecule: otp-input

```
OTP input
```

### molecule: pagination

```
Pagination
```

### molecule: popover

```
Popover and Menu, both on the native popover API (light dismiss and Esc for free).
   <button class="cu-btn cu-btn-outline" popovertarget="pop-1">Open</button>
   <div class="cu-popover" id="pop-1" popover>...any content...</div>

   comet.js places it next to its trigger. Placement: data-cu-placement="bottom-start" (default),
   "bottom-end", "top-start" or "top-end". It flips when there is no room.

   Menu surface, shared by Context menu and Menubar:
   <div class="cu-menu" id="menu-1" popover role="menu">
     <button class="cu-dropdown-item" role="menuitem">Rename <kbd class="cu-menu-shortcut">F2</kbd></button>
     <div class="cu-dropdown-divider"></div>
   </div>
```

### molecule: quantity-input

```
Quantity input (- 1 +)
   <div class="cu-quantity">
     <button type="button" class="cu-quantity-btn" data-cu-quantity="dec" aria-label="Decrease quantity">-</button>
     <input class="cu-quantity-input" type="number" value="1" min="1" max="10" step="1" aria-label="Quantity">
     <button type="button" class="cu-quantity-btn" data-cu-quantity="inc" aria-label="Increase quantity">+</button>
   </div>
   comet.js clamps to min/max, honours step and disables the buttons at the limits.
```

### molecule: radio-card

```
Radio card
```

### molecule: searchbar

```
Searchbar
   <div class="cu-searchbar">
     <svg class="cu-icon cu-searchbar-icon">...</svg>
     <input type="search" class="cu-input cu-searchbar-input" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search">
     <button type="button" class="cu-searchbar-clear" aria-label="Clear search"><svg class="cu-icon cu-icon-xs">...</svg></button>
   </div>
   comet.js shows the clear button when there is text and fires "cu:search" on Enter.
```

Segmented control

### molecule: stat-card

```
Stat card
   <div class="cu-stat">
     <div class="cu-stat-header"><span class="cu-stat-label">Revenue</span><span class="cu-stat-icon">...</span></div>
     <div class="cu-stat-value">Rp 48,2 jt</div>
     <div class="cu-stat-footer"><span class="cu-stat-delta cu-stat-delta-up">+12%</span><span class="cu-stat-hint">vs last month</span></div>
   </div>
```

### molecule: trace

```
Trace. The steps an agent took: reasoning, tool calls, sources, plans.
   <div class="cu-trace">
     <span class="cu-trace-line">
       <span class="cu-trace-icon" aria-hidden="true">...</span>
       <span class="cu-trace-title">Ran npm install</span>
       <span class="cu-trace-description">4.2s</span>
     </span>
     <details class="cu-trace-collapsible">
       <summary class="cu-trace-trigger">
         <span class="cu-trace-line" data-status="running">
           <span class="cu-trace-icon" aria-hidden="true">...</span>
           <span class="cu-trace-title">Reading 3 files</span>
         </span>
       </summary>
       <div class="cu-trace-content">...detail...</div>
     </details>
   </div>
   data-status on a line: none (done), "running" (title shimmers), "error", "pending" (not started).
   A line can also sit inside <a> or a button that opens a dialog, drawer or popover.
```

### organism: carousel

```
Carousel on CSS scroll snap, so swipe and trackpad work natively.
   <section class="cu-carousel" data-cu-carousel aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Featured">
     <div class="cu-carousel-viewport" tabindex="0">
       <div class="cu-carousel-slide" role="group" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="1 of 3">...</div>
       ...
     </div>
     <button type="button" class="cu-carousel-btn cu-carousel-prev" data-cu-carousel-prev aria-label="Previous slide">...</button>
     <button type="button" class="cu-carousel-btn cu-carousel-next" data-cu-carousel-next aria-label="Next slide">...</button>
     <div class="cu-carousel-dots"></div>
   </section>
   comet.js wires the buttons, disables them at the ends and builds the dots. Several slides per view:
   set --cu-carousel-slide, e.g. style="--cu-carousel-slide: 50%". Event: cu:slide.
```

### organism: chart

```
Chart. A themed container for TanStack Charts (@tanstack/charts, an optional peer dependency).
   Comet UI does not draw charts itself: TanStack Charts renders, this file makes it follow the theme and brand.

   <figure class="cu-chart">
     <figcaption class="cu-chart-header">
       <span class="cu-chart-title">Monthly revenue</span>
       <span class="cu-chart-description">January to June 2026</span>
     </figcaption>
     <div class="cu-chart-canvas" id="revenue"></div>
   </figure>

   import { defineChart, barY, mountChart } from '@tanstack/charts'
   mountChart(document.getElementById('revenue'), { definition, height: 280, ariaLabel: 'Monthly revenue' })

   Series colours come from --cu-chart-1 to --cu-chart-6 (semantic tokens, light and dark). Leave `fill` and
   `stroke` unset, or use 'var(--cu-chart-2)', so charts restyle when the theme or brand changes with no rebuild.
   Axis text and grid lines use currentColor. The tooltip uses the popover surface tokens.
   .cu-chart-plain removes the card frame.
```

### organism: command

```
Command. A searchable list of actions (command palette).
   <div class="cu-command" data-cu-command>
     <div class="cu-command-search">
       <svg class="cu-icon">...</svg>
       <input class="cu-command-input" placeholder="Type a command or search" aria-label="Command">
     </div>
     <div class="cu-command-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Commands">
       <p class="cu-command-group">Suggestions</p>
       <button type="button" class="cu-command-item" role="option" data-value="calendar">Calendar <kbd class="cu-menu-shortcut">Ctrl C</kbd></button>
       <p class="cu-command-empty" hidden>No results found.</p>
     </div>
   </div>
   Typing filters the items; Arrow keys move, Enter runs the active item and fires cu:command with its data-value.
   As a palette: put it in <dialog class="cu-dialog cu-command-dialog" id="palette" data-cu-hotkey="k">.
   data-cu-hotkey="k" opens that dialog with Ctrl+K or Cmd+K.
```

### organism: dialog-variants

```
Dialog variants
```

### organism: dialog

```
Dialog
```

### organism: drawer

```
Drawer (slide-in panel)
   A native <dialog>, so it traps focus, closes on Esc and inerts the page behind it.
   <dialog class="cu-drawer" id="filters" aria-labelledby="filters-title">
     <div class="cu-drawer-header"><h2 class="cu-drawer-title" id="filters-title">Filters</h2>
       <button class="cu-drawer-close" data-cu-close aria-label="Close">...</button></div>
     <div class="cu-drawer-body">...</div>
     <div class="cu-drawer-footer">...</div>
   </dialog>
   Open: <button data-cu-open="filters">. Sides: default right, .cu-drawer-left, .cu-drawer-bottom.
```

### organism: menubar

```
Menubar. A row of menus, like a desktop app.
   <div class="cu-menubar" role="menubar" aria-label="Editor" data-cu-menubar>
     <button type="button" class="cu-menubar-trigger" role="menuitem" popovertarget="mb-file">File</button>
     <div class="cu-menu" id="mb-file" popover role="menu">
       <button class="cu-dropdown-item" role="menuitem">New tab <kbd class="cu-menu-shortcut">Ctrl T</kbd></button>
     </div>
     ...
   </div>
   Left and Right move between menus, Down opens one, Esc closes. Once one is open, hovering another opens it.
```

### organism: message-scroller

```
Message scroller. The scroll container of a conversation.
   <div class="cu-message-scroller" data-cu-message-scroller data-cu-start="end" style="height: 24rem">
     <div class="cu-message-scroller-viewport" role="region" aria-label="Messages" tabindex="0">
       <div class="cu-message-scroller-content" role="log" aria-relevant="additions">
         <div class="cu-message-scroller-item" data-message-id="m1">...a .cu-message or .cu-marker...</div>
       </div>
     </div>
     <button type="button" class="cu-message-scroller-button" aria-label="Scroll to latest message">...</button>
   </div>
   It needs a fixed height (or a flex parent that gives it one).
   comet.js: follows new and streaming content while the reader is at the bottom, stops following when they
   scroll up, keeps their place when older messages are added on top, and shows the button when there is
   more below. data-cu-start: "end" (default) | "start" | "last-anchor" (the last item with data-cu-anchor).
   Script API: CometUI.scroller(element) returns { scrollToEnd, scrollToStart, scrollToMessage(id) }.
   Set aria-busy="true" on the content while a reply streams so screen readers wait for the full message.
   It does not store messages or talk to a model: your code adds and removes the items.
```

### organism: message

```
Message. The row around a bubble: avatar, sender, time and actions.
   <div class="cu-message">
     <div class="cu-message-avatar"><span class="cu-avatar">AL</span></div>
     <div class="cu-message-content">
       <div class="cu-message-header">Ayu Lestari</div>
       <div class="cu-bubble cu-bubble-secondary"><div class="cu-bubble-content">Hi!</div></div>
       <div class="cu-message-footer">09:41</div>
     </div>
   </div>
   The sender's own messages: add .cu-message-end (avatar, bubbles and footer move to the end side).
   Several messages from one sender: wrap in .cu-message-group and leave .cu-message-avatar empty on all but the last.
```

### organism: navigation-menu

```
Navigation menu. Site navigation with rich dropdown panels.
   <nav class="cu-nav-menu" aria-label="Main">
     <ul class="cu-nav-menu-list">
       <li><button type="button" class="cu-nav-menu-trigger" popovertarget="nav-products">Products <svg class="cu-icon cu-icon-xs">...</svg></button>
         <div class="cu-popover cu-nav-menu-content" id="nav-products" popover>
           <a class="cu-nav-menu-link" href="#"><span class="cu-nav-menu-link-title">Analytics</span><span class="cu-nav-menu-link-description">Understand your traffic.</span></a>
         </div>
       </li>
       <li><a class="cu-nav-menu-trigger" href="#">Pricing</a></li>
     </ul>
   </nav>
   Current page: aria-current="page" on the link.
```

### organism: questionnaire

```
Questionnaire. Questions asked one at a time: agent clarifying questions, onboarding, surveys.
   <form class="cu-questionnaire" data-cu-questionnaire data-cu-shortcuts="letters">
     <p class="cu-questionnaire-progress"></p>
     <fieldset class="cu-questionnaire-item" data-required>
       <legend class="cu-questionnaire-title">Which plan fits your team?</legend>
       <p class="cu-questionnaire-description">You can change it later.</p>
       <div class="cu-questionnaire-choices">
         <label class="cu-questionnaire-choice"><input type="radio" name="plan" value="starter"><span>Starter</span></label>
         <label class="cu-questionnaire-choice"><input type="radio" name="plan" value="team"><span>Team</span></label>
         <input class="cu-input cu-questionnaire-input" name="plan_other" placeholder="Something else" aria-label="Other plan">
       </div>
       <p class="cu-questionnaire-error" role="alert" hidden>Choose an answer to continue.</p>
     </fieldset>
     ...more fieldsets...
     <div class="cu-questionnaire-actions">
       <button type="button" class="cu-btn cu-btn-ghost" data-cu-q="prev">Back</button>
       <button type="button" class="cu-btn cu-btn-ghost" data-cu-q="skip">Skip</button>
       <button type="button" class="cu-btn cu-btn-primary" data-cu-q="next">Next</button>
       <button type="submit" class="cu-btn cu-btn-primary" data-cu-q="submit">Submit</button>
     </div>
   </form>
   Radios for one answer, checkboxes for several. data-required makes an item mandatory; items without it get Skip.
   data-cu-shortcuts="letters" (A, B, C) or "numbers" (1, 2, 3) adds a key for each choice.
   comet.js shows one item at a time, fills the progress line, validates before moving on and fires
   cu:questionnaire with { answers } on a valid submit. The form still submits natively: call
   event.preventDefault() in your own submit listener to handle it in script.
```

### organism: resizable

```
Resizable panels. Two panels with a draggable divider.
   <div class="cu-resizable" data-cu-resizable style="height: 16rem">
     <div class="cu-resizable-panel" style="flex-basis: 35%">...</div>
     <div class="cu-resizable-handle" role="separator" tabindex="0" aria-orientation="vertical" aria-label="Resize panels"></div>
     <div class="cu-resizable-panel">...</div>
   </div>
   Drag the handle, or focus it and use the Arrow keys (Home and End jump to the limits).
   Limits: data-cu-min="15" data-cu-max="85" (percent of the first panel). Stacked: add .cu-resizable-vertical
   and aria-orientation="horizontal" on the handle. Event: cu:resize.
```

### organism: sidebar

```
Sidebar
   <aside class="cu-sidebar" aria-label="Main">
     <div class="cu-sidebar-header">...brand...</div>
     <nav class="cu-sidebar-nav">
       <p class="cu-sidebar-group">Overview</p>
       <a class="cu-sidebar-link is-active" href="#" aria-current="page"><svg class="cu-icon">...</svg>Dashboard</a>
       <a class="cu-sidebar-link" href="#">Reports <span class="cu-sidebar-badge">3</span></a>
     </nav>
     <div class="cu-sidebar-footer">...user...</div>
   </aside>
   Inside .cu-app-shell it collapses to an off-canvas panel below 48rem (see templates/app-shell.css).
```

### organism: table

```
Data table with sorting, filtering and pagination
   <div class="cu-table-wrap" data-cu-table data-cu-page-size="5">
     <div class="cu-table-toolbar">
       <div class="cu-searchbar" ...><input data-cu-table-filter ...></div>
       <select class="cu-select" data-cu-table-column="2">...</select>   optional exact-match filter on column 2
     </div>
     <div class="cu-table-scroll">
       <table class="cu-table">
         <thead><tr>
           <th aria-sort="none" data-cu-sort="text"><button class="cu-table-sort">Name<span class="cu-table-sort-icon"></span></button></th>
           <th class="cu-table-num" aria-sort="none" data-cu-sort="number">...</th>
         </tr></thead>
         <tbody>...</tbody>
       </table>
     </div>
     <div class="cu-table-footer"><span data-cu-table-summary></span><nav class="cu-pagination" data-cu-table-pagination aria-label="Pagination"></nav></div>
   </div>
   Sort types: text, number, date. Put data-sort="..." on a td to sort by a value other than its text.
```

### organism: tabs

```
Tabs
   <div class="cu-tabs" data-cu-tabs>
     <div class="cu-tabs-list" role="tablist" aria-label="Account">
       <button class="cu-tab" role="tab" id="t1" aria-controls="p1" aria-selected="true">Profile</button>
       <button class="cu-tab" role="tab" id="t2" aria-controls="p2" aria-selected="false">Billing</button>
     </div>
     <div class="cu-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="p1" aria-labelledby="t1">...</div>
     <div class="cu-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="p2" aria-labelledby="t2" hidden>...</div>
   </div>
   comet.js handles click, Arrow keys, Home and End, and roving tabindex. Pill style: .cu-tabs-pill.
```

### organism: toast

```
Toast
   Create toasts from JavaScript:
     CometUI.toast({ title: 'Saved', description: 'Changes are live.', variant: 'success', duration: 5000 })
   comet.js adds a .cu-toast-region (a popover, so it sits above open dialogs) and removes
   toasts after `duration` ms. Hovering or focusing a toast pauses its timer.
   Variants: default, success, warning, destructive, info. Position with
   CometUI.toast.position('top-right' | 'top-center' | 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-center').
```

```
Topbar
```

### template: app-shell

```
App shell = topbar + sidebar + content.
   <div class="cu-app-shell" data-cu-shell>
     <aside class="cu-sidebar" id="shell-sidebar">...</aside>
     <div class="cu-app-shell-main">
       <header class="cu-app-shell-header">
         <button class="cu-app-shell-toggle" data-cu-shell-toggle aria-controls="shell-sidebar" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Menu">...</button>
         ...
       </header>
       <main class="cu-app-shell-content">...</main>
     </div>
   </div>
   Below 48rem the sidebar slides in; comet.js toggles .is-open on the shell.
```
